mainEntity.name: How much do fall prevention home modifications typically cost in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of fall prevention home modifications in the Bay Area can vary widely depending on the type and extent of the work. Simple installations like grab bars might cost a few hundred dollars, while more extensive projects such as bathroom remodels for accessibility or ramp installations could range from several thousands to tens of thousands. Factors like material choices, labor rates in the Bay Area, and the complexity of your home's structure will influence the final price. We provide detailed estimates after an initial assessment.
